_readme: The one list of what this shop publishes. risegm.com/skills renders its cards from this file, so a new entry here is a new card on the site. Slugs are published anchors (risegm.com/skills#<slug>): never rename or remove one. Optional field image: a repo-relative path to the card image. Check with: python3 scripts/check_catalog.py

items.name: Ad creative library
items.summary: Your brand kit, photo bank, templates and test roadmap in one Figma file. Claude maps what you've tested, plans each batch, builds 4:5 and 9:16 statics layer by layer, and runs size, sharpness and claim checks before handing you files to upload.
items.needs: A paid Figma Full or Dev seat (Figma MCP), Python, a Gemini API key

items.name: Ad Library creative intel
items.summary: Harvest any brand's ads from the Meta Ad Library, videos included, then run computer vision over every frame. Hooks, formats, claims, pacing... a creative teardown that works on competitors.
items.needs: Python, Playwright, ffmpeg, a Gemini API key

items.name: The AI account manager
items.summary: Weekly reporting decks drafted from live ad data plus a daily data-health check. The system we built when our account manager left, packaged to run on your accounts.
items.needs: Python, a Google Apps Script bridge, your Meta and Google Ads API access

items.name: Vertical ad production
items.summary: Product page URL in, finished 9:16 video ad out. Script, characters, scene generation, audio, and an editable timeline for the final cut.
items.needs: Gemini, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield and Suno accounts, ffmpeg, Final Cut Pro

items.name: Multi-size creative adapter
items.summary: One master creative becomes every ad size you need. Layout-aware adaptation, not a dumb crop.
items.needs: Python, Pillow, a Gemini API key

items.name: Google Workspace bridge
items.summary: Create fully formatted Google Docs, Sheets, and styled Slides decks straight from Claude Code, through your own Apps Script bridge.

items.name: Dialectical debate
items.summary: Stress-test any claim or decision. Opposing agents investigate independently, cross-examine each other, and return a confidence-rated verdict.

items.name: Strategy crystallizer
items.summary: Run any brand question through Rumelt's strategy kernel. A falsifiable one-sentence thesis, coherent actions, explicit refusals, graded out of 70.
